name: Slug Generator
description: Turn any post title into a clean URL slug for your blog or website — lowercase, hyphenated and ready to paste into your CMS.

howto: Paste your post title into the input.

features: Instant slug generation from any title
Optional stop-word removal for shorter URLs

faq.a: The readable part of a URL that identifies a page — for example in example.com/grow-tomatoes-small-spaces, the slug is grow-tomatoes-small-spaces. Clean slugs help SEO and usability.

faq.q: Should I use hyphens or underscores?
faq.a: Hyphens. Search engines treat hyphens as word separators, so each word is indexed individually. Underscores are not treated the same way.
Words like a, the, of and to add little meaning. Removing them yields shorter, cleaner slugs that are easier to read and share.
No. It only generates the slug text. You paste it into your CMS when creating the post.
